title: Paris butter shop – level 1
paragraphs: A special shop in Paris sells 30 different types of butter. People can buy sweet butter with chocolate, vanilla, or raspberry. They can also buy butter with garlic, onion, and herbs.

Butter from different places has different amounts of fat, which changes the taste. Good butter is very creamy and melts easily on your tongue. It tastes much better than simple butter from the supermarket.
Trying these new and rich flavors opens a big new world for food lovers. Today, many people are excited to try this tasty French food.
